summary: Loads the title-screen bitmap resource. When global flag dword_7D0398 (fill label: PhotoFreeCameraFlag) is zero, loads the default title bitmap aGametitleBmp and returns that result directly. Otherwise attempts the magazine/promotional splash aPmbeltiteMag and falls back to aGametitleBmp when the magazine load does not return byte value 1. Returns the last ResourceFileLoader result.

operations.description: If dword_7D0398 is zero (fill label: PhotoFreeCameraFlag clear), skip the magazine-splash path and load the default title bitmap.
ResourceFileLoader(aGametitleBmp, 0.0, 0): load the default title-screen bitmap and return its result directly.
Return the ResourceFileLoader result from the flag-clear path.
result = ResourceFileLoader(aPmbeltiteMag, 0.0, 0): attempt to load the magazine/promotional splash bitmap.
If the low byte of the magazine load result is not 1, treat the load as failed and fall back to the default title bitmap.
ResourceFileLoader(aGametitleBmp, 0.0, 0): load the default title bitmap on the fallback path.
Return the magazine loader result when it succeeded (byte value 1).
